card.line: Naioth was a place near Ramah where Samuel stayed with the prophets. David hid there from King Saul, and God protected him.

moments.title: David Hides with Samuel
moments.text: David ran away from Saul and told Samuel everything Saul had done to him. Then David and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

moments.title: Saul's Messengers Prophesy
moments.text: Saul sent messengers three times to seize David. Each time, the Spirit of God came upon them and they began to prophesy instead.

moments.title: Saul Prophesies at Naioth
moments.text: Saul went to Naioth himself, and the Spirit of God came upon him too. He prophesied, took off his robes, and lay there all day and night.

moments.title: David Flees to Jonathan
moments.text: David left Naioth and went to Jonathan. He asked what he had done wrong that Saul wanted to take his life.
